title: Trunk size and opening

positive.summary: One positive fragment notes that the trunk and console box are smaller now without giving a clear benefit beyond the stated size change.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention a cramped or small trunk area that limits luggage use and one case where the trunk sometimes does not open, but the sample is too limited to separate these into clearer sentiment categories.
